senses.gloss: रैभ m. patr. fr. रेभ, Cat.
रै॑भी f. N. of partic. ritualistic verses (esp. of AV. xx, 127, 4-6; containing several repetitions of the word रेभ).
रै॑भ्य m. (or रैभ्य॑) (fr. रेभ) N. of various men, ĀśvŚr.; MBh. &c.
of a son of Sumati and father of Duṣyanta, BhP.
of a class of gods, Hariv. (Nīlak.)
